sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about stress; it is a code-retirement form. p. 2: 'There is no documentation based on direct research in Lyons listed in OLAC or Glottolog. Thus, we are left with no substantive evidence that the language ever existed.' Bickford speculates the original Ethnologue 12 (1992) entry reflected dialect variation within French Sign Language [fsl].
